estimate.damage_summary: An atmospheric overvoltage damaged a speaker system and TV connected to the building’s electrical installation. A technician also attended to diagnose the surge failure and check wiring safety.
estimate.policy_notes: The damaged electronics are covered for the overvoltage peril, subject to the EUR 5,000 (including VAT) aggregate appliance sub-limit and the no-improvement standard. Because the description establishes that no affected appliance was connected through a surge-protective device, the policy halves the otherwise payable indemnity for the appliances and their indemnifiable accessories. Diagnostic/reporting and attendance costs are not indemnifiable repair costs on the stated facts; attendance is covered only when incurred on the same invoice as indemnifiable work, and the policy also excludes charges for service or arrangement administration. No deductible is specified.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: Both appliances are reported physically damaged by the insured overvoltage event, so replacement to the pre-loss standard is plausibly covered. The invoiced quantity matches the two appliances; the appliance sub-limit may constrain the aggregate settlement, and the missing surge protection halves the otherwise payable amount.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The diagnostic visit relates to the reported event, but confirming the failure and checking wiring are investigative/safety services rather than making good physical damage. The call-out is not payable on these facts without indemnifiable work on that attendance, and three pieces are not plausible for one report and one visit; prices below assume a valid unit of this combined service.
